text:
Type: geometric print square cushion
Use: back support and a pattern accent on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom, reading corner
Style: Scandinavian, mid-century modern, bohemian
Materials: printed cotton cover, soft filling
Colors: off-white, black, warm brown, grey, sand beige
Shape: square and plump, all-over pattern of tapering trapezoid blocks in rows like a woven kilim, slightly rounded corners, medium size
Feel: graphic, warm, earthy, lively
Goes with: grey or charcoal sofas, warm wood, leather, cream walls; Scandinavian, bohemian or mid-century rooms

product.name: MALISEN
product.description: Cotton velvet gives depth to the colour and softness to the touch.
